name: io.github.tukorama/mcp-server-polymarket
title: Polymarket (unofficial)
description: Polymarket prediction markets and perps: market data, positions, accounts and gated trading. Unofficial.

environmentVariables.name: POLYMARKET_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Tool groups to expose, e.g. auto, all, predictions, perps, or auto,+sports,-docs.

environmentVariables.name: POLYMARKET_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: CLOB API key for reading your orders and trades. Not needed after `mcp-server-polymarket auth`.

environmentVariables.name: POLYMARKET_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Signer address the CLOB API credentials belong to.

environmentVariables.name: POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File holding the signing key. Signing needs the `signing` extra.

environmentVariables.name: POLYMARKET_WALLET_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Your Polymarket wallet (the address shown in your profile). Required for signing.

environmentVariables.name: POLYMARKET_ALLOW_TRADING
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose order placement and cancellation tools.

environmentVariables.name: POLYMARKET_ALLOW_TRANSFERS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose deposit, withdrawal and transfer tools.

environmentVariables.name: POLYMARKET_MAX_ORDER_USD
environmentVariables.description: Largest order value in USD a single tool call may place (default 100).
